label: Adapter-detection setting
justification: Galaxy cards: adapter autodetection enabled although the task required mate-overlap-only detection; the custom-code card: an extra pair-filtering step beside overlap trimming.

label: Additional peptide–protein pairs
justification: Card only says all reference pairs were recovered and extra pairs lowered precision; evidence matches 'Over-permissive peptide validation' runs (139 of 144).

label: Borderline pair classification
justification: Task allows any suitable paired-end aligner; BWA-MEM or minimap2 differed only at ambiguous proper-pair boundaries; files complete and synchronized.

label: DESeq2 implementation difference
subcategory: Tool version or implementation differs from the reference
justification: Python DESeq2 implementation reproduced every gene and direction; numerical fitting changed one borderline significance call.

label: DESeq2 normalization choice
justification: PyDESeq2 with the poscounts size-factor option; the task does not specify size factors; matrix exact, table valid.

label: Denoising decision boundary
justification: Card describes the mechanism (combined denoising, merging and chimera boundary) but not what the agent did differently.

label: Different ASV set after denoising
justification: Galaxy DADA2 run kept fewer reads and a different ASV set; the card gives no setting or step as the cause.

label: Differential-expression method
justification: Task asks for 'a standard differential-expression analysis'; edgeR was used and scored against a DESeq2 target.

label: Extra summit splitting
justification: Task asks for one BED record per reported interval, even duplicates, so summit-split output is anticipated; one-to-one matching penalises it.

label: Floating-point precision
justification: Card: result identical to the target; the deficit comes only from floating-point serialization.

label: Generic negative-binomial model
justification: Card: a generic model rather than edgeR or DESeq2; 0 significant genes versus 49. Page does not call it an error explicitly.

label: Invalid multiple-testing correction
justification: Submitted fdr values were not the Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment the task explicitly required (difference 0.00342, tolerance 0.000001).

label: Minor peak-boundary differences
justification: Card: peak set nearly identical to the calibrated protocol's reference; small boundary and count differences only.

label: Missing chimera removal
justification: Card: the workflow did not include the de novo chimera-removal step the task requires.

label: Over-aggressive read filtering
justification: Card: filtering, truncation and merging were more aggressive than the benchmark settings, losing depth and shifting the ASV set.

label: Over-permissive peptide validation
justification: Card: the verification criterion accepted extra peptides beyond the target set; precision lost.

label: Over-restrictive peptide validation
justification: Card: verification and assignment criteria rejected too many target pairs (30 of 139 missing).

label: Peak-boundary variation
justification: Card: method-specific target (Bowtie2 + MACS3 or Genrich); small boundary differences only; peak caller choice is open in the task.

label: Peptide-pair substitution
justification: Totals correct but 5 pairs substituted; card says only that it 'points to' acceptance or assignment decisions.

label: PyDESeq2 implementation variation
subcategory: Tool version or implementation differs from the reference
justification: Card: PyDESeq2 fitted values differ slightly from the calibrated Galaxy/R DESeq2 output; matrix exact.

label: Sample identifiers
subcategory: Output delivered in the wrong format or under the wrong name
justification: All 17 sample names converted to lowercase, so no column matched the supplied case-sensitive identifiers.

label: Sequence differences from the reference
justification: Card reports only that 31-base fragment content differs from the reference assembly.

label: Unmatched mitochondrial sequence
justification: Submitted sequence shares no 31-base fragments with the reference; the card gives no cause.

label: edgeR fitting variation
subcategory: Tool version or implementation differs from the reference
justification: Card: different fitted statistics from the calibrated edgeR output; cause not detailed (one Galaxy run used Galaxy edgeR).
